plan.title: DRV-CO-017 Bulk Counter Offer Accept Scroll

steps.note: Create the RFQ event required for the counter-offer scenario.

args.title: DRV-CO-017 Bulk Counter Offer Scroll Test

steps.note: Use an RFQ pricing stage for vendor bidding and counter offers.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Create many line items so the vendor counter-offer view requires substantial scrolling.
Invite the QA vendor who will place and receive the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the invited vendor's bid, which is required before sending a counter offer.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's bulk counter-offer flow for the submitted bid.

args.goal: on the buyer screen, complete and send the bulk counter offer for the submitted vendor bid across the many line items, then stop when the screen shows the offer was sent

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated bulk-counter-offer submission step, so complete that buyer-side flow on screen.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer and acceptance action should be available.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the pending counter offer.
Attempt to scroll to the acceptance control at the bottom of the large counter-offer view.
Attempt the acceptance action and record refusal or inability to open the acceptance flow.
